field_notes.bulk_provider_conventions: Every bulk_provider record carries one opaque per-recipient token: the first sixteen hex characters of SHA-256 over seed|id|recipient-token. The generator appends it to every link on the tracking host (/c/account/campaign/link/token for a click, /v/account/campaign/token for view-in-browser, /u/account/campaign/token for unsubscribe), to the List-Unsubscribe URL, and to the bounce address bounce-account-campaign-token@bounce.sendbarrow-mail.example in Return-Path and Received-SPF and its unsub- mailto twin, so a click, a bounce and a one-click unsubscribe each identify the recipient (RFC 8058 section 3.1). The HTML part is a full html and body document that opens, after the gateway banner, with a view-in-browser line; the plain part carries the same line and the same three links. The provider's app node stamps Date in +0000, matching its own Received line and Message-ID; the manifest date field keeps the organization's local offset for the same instant.
